title: Good news, red day
summary: A company beats earnings and the stock falls anyway. Here's the concept that explains it.

cards.headline: Good news, red day
cards.body: A company can beat earnings and still fall. Price moves on the gap between results and expectations, not results alone. If the market already priced in a great quarter, merely great isn't enough. The surprise is what moves the stock.

cards.headline: It's about the surprise
cards.body: "Priced in" means today's price already reflects what everyone expects. Clear a low bar and the stock can jump; miss a high one and it drops. That's why the reaction, not the headline number, is the part worth reading.

cards.title: The takeaway
cards.summary: A stock reacts to the surprise versus expectations, not to good or bad news by itself.
bullets: Expectations are the bar; results are the jump over it.
A beat everyone expected can still disappoint.
Read the reaction to learn what was already priced in.
